title: Flow-control: dynamic admission & fast-fail policies to prevent GPU overcommit during traffic surges
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Planned action items (scoped, owners, rough estimates):
1) Edge admission controller (Aisha / Marcus) - implement a global fast-fail policy and per-tenant token-bucket with burst allowance (estimate 5 pts).
2) Autoscaler tuning (Diego / infra) - reduce scale-out evaluation window, add predictive short-term scaling based on request-rate momentum (3 pts).
3) Host draining UX (Sana / serving) - implement graceful eviction for long-running KV-heavy sessions to avoid head-of-line blocking (5 pts).
4) Per-model KV-cache diagnostics & mitigations (R&D) - detect thrash patterns and apply conservative cache policies per-model (4 pts).
5) Telemetry & alerts (observability) - add queue-latency SLI, host accept-rate anomaly alert, and tenant saturation dashboard (2 pts).
6) Runbook & automated remediation playbook (oncall) - steps to enable emergency tenant throttles and soft-degrade rules (2 pts).
comments: 2026-03-01 - Aisha: Initial ticket created after incident postmortem readout. Assigned to Marcus to lead flow-control work.

2026-03-03 - Marcus: Prototype for per-tenant token-bucket admission controller submitted in draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3971. Requires review from infra and security for quota accounting side-effects.

2026-03-05 - Diego: Autoscaler changes staged; reduced evaluation_window from 60s -> 20s and added rate-derivative input. Deployed to canary pool; observed 40% faster scale-up in synthetic spike testing.
2026-03-07 - Ops: Emergency tenant throttle flow verified in staging; runbook draft available at https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/INC-TenantThrottle-Runbook.

2026-03-09 - Design review: Decided to prefer soft-degrades (model substitution) over immediate 50% hard-throttles for high-value customers; added opt-out flag for premium tiers. Marcus to add policy gating.
2026-03-10 - Marcus: Blocking item discovered - per-tenant accounting needs to read token usage from async logs; opened ENG-18505 to add a synchronous brightline counter.
